description: This file contains a codemod transformer script that modifies React components to replace 'url' references with 'router' and wraps default exports with 'withRouter'. It manages imports and updates various component methods and properties related to URL routing.

methods.name: addWithRouterImport
methods.description: Adds or appends the 'withRouter' import from 'next/router' to the file.

methods.name: getPropsUrlNodes
methods.description: Finds member expressions accessing 'props.url' for a given variable name.

methods.name: wrapNodeInFunction
methods.description: Wraps a node in a function call, e.g., 'withRouter(node)'.

methods.name: turnUrlIntoRouter
methods.description: Replaces all identifiers named 'url' with 'router' in the AST.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Main function that applies transformations to React components to replace 'url' with 'router' and wrap with 'withRouter'.
